observations.title: Cloudflare postpones AI Search billing to December 1 and slows default sync
observations.claim: Cloudflare's November 2, 2026 first-party changelog postpones AI Search usage billing from November 1 to December 1, 2026. It states AI Search usage will not be charged before December 1 and published rates/included allowances remain unchanged. Default instance sync interval changes from 6 hours to 24 hours; supported custom intervals range from 15 minutes to 24 hours.
observations.why_now: Directly contradicts the previously recorded November 1 billing-start date for this same subject, and materially changes default source freshness. The earlier entry remains immutable as historical evidence; this is a verified terms change, not a source-hash change. No active founder AI Search instance or billing exposure is established.
observations.value: One additional month before AI Search usage charges begin (December 1); no cash or guaranteed savings, and no waiver of separately billed Cloudflare or third-party services. Reduced default sync frequency can lower freshness for time-sensitive alerts.
observations.eligibility: Cloudflare AI Search users on Workers Free or Paid plans. Account-specific instances, limits and billing settings are unverified.
observations.friction: Review any instance's configured sync interval if relying on sub-24-hour updates. More frequent syncs may consume usage allowances and later incur charges; other model/generation services can bill separately. No activation or migration is needed for this research project.
